53263-the-mystery-of-m-felix.title: The Mystery Of M. Felix
53263-the-mystery-of-m-felix.creator: J. W. Lovell Co.
53263-the-mystery-of-m-felix.description: A book by J. W. Lovell Co.. THE FLIGHT AND THE RESCUE. LIGHT SHINES THROUGH THE DARK CLOUDS. LEONARD MEETS WITH A FELLOW-SCOUNDREL. PETERSSEN EXPLAINS HIMSELF. "ONLY YOU AND I, DARLING, ONLY YOU AND I."  XXXVII. PETERSSEN REAPPEARS ON THE SCENE.

arxiv-1909-07714.title: An open-source, end-to-end workflow for multidimensional photoemission spectroscopy
arxiv-1909-07714.creator: R. Patrick Xian, Yves Acremann, Steinn Y. Agustsson, Maciej Dendzik, Kevin Bühlmann, Davide Curcio, Dmytro Kutnyakhov, Federico Pressacco, Michael Heber, Shuo Dong, Tommaso Pincelli, Jure Demsar, Wilfried Wurth, Philip Hofmann, Martin Wolf, Markus Scheidgen, Laurenz Rettig, Ralph Ernstorfer
arxiv-1909-07714.description: Abstract Abstract Characterization of the electronic band structure of solid state materials is routinely performed using photoemission spectroscopy. Recent advancements in short-wavelength light sources and electron detectors give rise to multidimensional photoemission spectroscopy, allowing parallel measurements of the electron spectral function simultaneously in energy, two momentum components and additional physical parameters with single-event detection capability.

arxiv-2009-14220.title: Neutrino Oscillation Constraints on U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} Models: from Non-Standard Interactions to Long-Range Forces Preprint: IFT-UAM/CSIC-20-133, YITP-SB-2020-30
arxiv-2009-14220.creator: Pilar Coloma, M. C. Gonzalez-Garcia, Michele Maltoni
arxiv-2009-14220.description: Abstract We quantify the effect of gauge bosons from a weakly coupled lepton flavor dependent U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} interaction on the matter background in the evolution of solar, atmospheric, reactor and long-baseline accelerator neutrinos in the global analysis of oscillation data.

arxiv-2106-05736.title: Charged reflecting shells supporting non-minimally coupled massless scalar field configurations
arxiv-2106-05736.creator: Shahar Hod
arxiv-2106-05736.description: Abstract We study analytically the physical and mathematical properties of spatially regular massless scalar field configurations which are non-minimally coupled to the electromagnetic field of a spherically symmetric charged reflecting shell. In particular, the Klein-Gordon wave equation for the composed charged-reflecting-shell-nonminimally-coupled-linearized-massless-scalar-field system is solved analytically.

arxiv-2111-13494.title: The Weighted Bitcoin Lightning Network Thanks: tiziano.squartini@imtlucca.it
arxiv-2111-13494.creator: Jian-Hong Lin, Emiliano Marchese, Claudio J. Tessone, Tiziano Squartini
arxiv-2111-13494.description: Abstract The Bitcoin Lightning Network (BLN) was launched in 2018 to scale up the number of transactions between Bitcoin owners. Although several contributions concerning the analysis of the BLN binary structure have recently appeared in the literature, the properties of its weighted counterpart are still largely unknown.

arxiv-2207-01002.title: Supervised learning for improving the accuracy of robot-mounted 3D camera applied to human gait analysis. Journal: XXXX-XXXX
arxiv-2207-01002.creator: Diego Guffanti, Alberto Brunete, Miguel Hernando, David Álvarez, Javier Rueda, Enrique Navarro
arxiv-2207-01002.description: Abstract The use of 3D cameras for gait analysis has been highly questioned due to the low accuracy they have demonstrated in the past. The objective of the study presented in this paper is to improve the accuracy of the estimations made by robot-mounted 3D cameras in human gait analysis by applying a supervised learning stage.

arxiv-2208-09566.title: Primordial black holes and mirror dark matter
arxiv-2208-09566.creator: Teruyuki Kitabayashi
arxiv-2208-09566.description: Abstract If mirror matter exists but cannot comprise all of the dark matter (DM) in the universe, we can expect that the additional DM component may only interact with the other sectors gravitationally. One of the natural candidate of a gravitationally interacting component is a primordial black hole (PBH).

arxiv-2303-02099.title: Orbital decay in the classroom
arxiv-2303-02099.creator: Carlos Chaparro 1 , Andrea Ferroglia 2,3 , Miguel C. N. Fiolhais 1,3,4 , Luis González-Urbina 1 , Tomasz Milewski 1 1 Science Department, Borough of Manhattan Community College, The City University of New York, 199 Chambers St, New York, NY 10007, USA 2 Physics Department, New York City College of T
arxiv-2303-02099.description: Abstract The objective of this paper is to provide a pedagogical framework for the phenomenon of orbital decay of satellites in low Earth orbit. The dynamics of orbital decay are derived considering atmospheric drag as the only dissipative mechanism and using an educational approach suitable for undergraduate calculus-based physics and engineering courses.

arxiv-2309-08701.title: Performance Metrics for Probabilistic Ordinal Classifiers
arxiv-2309-08701.creator: Adrian Galdran ,✉ {}^{\textrm{,{\char 0\relax}}}
arxiv-2309-08701.description: Abstract Ordinal classification models assign higher penalties to predictions further away from the true class. As a result, they are appropriate for relevant diagnostic tasks like disease progression prediction or medical image grading. The consensus for assessing their categorical predictions dictates the use of distance-sensitive metrics like the Quadratic-Weighted Kappa score or the Expected Cost.

arxiv-2406-08558.title: High-resolution transmission spectroscopy of warm Jupiters: An ESPRESSO sample with predictions for ANDES
arxiv-2406-08558.creator: Bibiana Prinoth, Elyar Sedaghati, Julia V. Seidel, H. Jens Hoeijmakers, Rafael Brahm, Brian Thorsbro, Andrés Jordán
arxiv-2406-08558.description: Abstract Warm Jupiters are ideal laboratories for testing the limitations of current tools for atmospheric studies. The cross-correlation technique is a commonly used method to investigate the atmospheres of close-in planets, leveraging their large orbital velocities to separate the spectrum of the planet from that of the star.

arxiv-2506-23404.title: Characterizing Small Circuit Classes from 𝐅𝐀𝐂 0 \mathbf{FAC}^{0} to 𝐅𝐀𝐂 1 \mathbf{FAC}^{1} via Discrete Ordinary Differential Equations
arxiv-2506-23404.creator: Melissa Antonelli, Arnaud Durand, Juha Kontinen
arxiv-2506-23404.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Melissa Antonelli, Arnaud Durand, Juha Kontinen. In this paper, we provide a uniform framework for investigating small circuit classes and bounds through the lens of ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Following an approach recently introduced to capture the class of polynomial-time computable functions via ODE-based recursion schemas and later applied to the context of functions computed by unbounded fan-in circuits of constant depth ( 𝐅𝐀𝐂 0 \mathbf{FAC}^{0} ), we study multiple relevant small circuit classes.

arxiv-2510-01607.title: ActiveUMI: Robotic Manipulation with Active Perception from Robot‑Free Human Demonstrations
arxiv-2510-01607.creator: Qiyuan Zeng , Chengmeng Li, Jude St. John, Zhongyi Zhou, Junjie Wen, Guorui Feng, Yichen Zhu, Yi Xu
arxiv-2510-01607.description: Abstract We present ActiveUMI, a framework for a data collection system that transfers in-the-wild human demonstrations to robots capable of complex bimanual manipulation. ActiveUMI couples a portable VR teleoperation kit with sensorized controllers that mirror the robot’s end-effectors, bridging human-robot kinematics via precise pose alignment.

arxiv-2510-25919.title: Geometric and Orbital Control of Correlated States in Small Hubbard Clusters
arxiv-2510-25919.creator: Shivanshu Dwivedi, Kalum Palandage
arxiv-2510-25919.description: Abstract Arrays of semiconductor quantum dots provide a powerful platform to design correlated quantum matter from the bottom up. We establish a predictive framework for engineering local electron pairing in these artificial molecules by systematically deploying three control levers: lattice geometry, orbital hybridization, and external electric fields.

arxiv-2601-01844.title: Clinical Knowledge Graph Construction and Evaluation with Multi-LLMs via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2601-01844.creator: Udiptaman Das, Krishnasai B. Atmakuri, Duy Ho, Chi Lee, Yugyung Lee
arxiv-2601-01844.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for constructing knowledge graphs (KGs) from unstructured clinical narratives. However, existing approaches often rely on structured inputs and lack robust validation of factual accuracy and semantic consistency—limitations that are especially problematic in oncology.

The RNA methyltransferases METTL3 and METTL14 are components of a multisubunit...

pmc-10743277.title: The Development and Validation of an AI Diagnostic Model for Sacroiliitis: A Deep-Learning Approach
pmc-10743277.creator: Kyu-Hong Lee, Ro-Woon Lee, Kyung-Hee Lee, Won Park, Seong-Ryul Kwon, Mie-Jin Lim, Kevin V Hackshaw
pmc-10743277.description: Purpose: Sacroiliitis refers to the inflammatory condition of the sacroiliac joints, frequently causing lower back pain. It is often associated with systemic conditions. However, its signs on radiographic images can be subtle, which may result in it being overlooked or underdiagnosed.

pmc-11353839.title: Cross-Modality Person Re-Identification Method with Joint-Modality Generation and Feature Enhancement
pmc-11353839.creator: Yihan Bi, Rong Wang, Qianli Zhou, Zhaolong Zeng, Ronghui Lin, Mingjie Wang, Sotiris Kotsiantis
pmc-11353839.description: In order to minimize the disparity between visible and infrared modalities and enhance pedestrian feature representation, a cross-modality person re-identification method is proposed, which integrates modality generation and feature enhancement. Specifically, a lightweight network is used for dimension reduction and augmentation of visible images, and intermediate modalities are generated to bridge the gap between visible images and infrared images.

pmc-11440445.title: Assessing Telehealth in Palliative Care: A Systematic Review of the Effectiveness and Challenges in Rural and Underserved Areas
pmc-11440445.creator: Kamal Y Ghazal, Shreya Singh Beniwal, Avleen Dhingra
pmc-11440445.description: The integration of telehealth into palliative care has garnered significant attention due to its potential to enhance both access and quality of care, particularly for patients in rural and underserved areas. This interest stems from the need to address geographical and logistical barriers that traditionally hinder palliative care delivery.

pmc-11545302.title: Effect of Blood Sampling Time After Colostrum Intake on the Concentration of Metabolites Indicative of the Passive Immunity Transfer in Newborn Dairy Calves
pmc-11545302.creator: Mohammad Hassan Mortazavi, Nathalia Brito Rocha, Marília Ribeiro de Paula, Evangelina Miqueo, Marcia Saladini Vieira Salles, Paulo Henrique Mazza Rodrigues, Carla Maris Machado Bittar, Marian Czauderna
pmc-11545302.description: Simple SummaryNewborn calves are agammaglobulinemic, meaning that they are born without the protective antibodies that help protect against infections. As a result, the transfer of passive immunity through colostrum becomes crucial for the health and survival of these calves, significantly impacting their morbidity and mortality rates, and their growth.

pmc-12711306.title: Transportation barriers, loneliness, and depressive/anxiety symptoms in older adults
pmc-12711306.creator: Namkee G Choi, C Nathan Marti
pmc-12711306.description: Background and ObjectivesTransportation is crucial to maintaining social engagement in later life. Lack of transportation is significantly associated with depressive/anxiety symptoms in older adults. In this study, we examined the extent to which loneliness mediates the relationship between transportation barriers and depressive/anxiety symptoms.

pmc-13249499.title: Secondary Pulmonary Alveolar Proteinosis Associated With Ruxolitinib After Bone‐Marrow Transplantation: A Case With Transient Improvement Following Drug Discontinuation
pmc-13249499.creator: Taiki Yanagi, Maki Asami‐Noyama, Kaoru Yamamoto, Yoshinobu Hoshii, Yasushi Ichiyama, Masatoshi Okimura, Tetsuya Fujii, Junki Suizu, Misa Harada, Keita Murakawa, Kazuki Hamada, Toshiaki Utsunomiya, Yoriyuki Murata, Keiji Oishi, Nobutaka Edakuni, Tomoyuki Kakugawa, Tsunahiko Hirano, Kazuto Matsunaga
pmc-13249499.description: Ruxolitinib is a Janus kinase (JAK) 1/2 inhibitor used to treat steroid‐refractory graft‐versus‐host disease, wherein pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP) is a rare complication. We report the case of a 47‐year‐old woman developing respiratory failure 8 months after commencing ruxolitinib treatment. Chest computed tomography revealed bilateral ground‐glass opacities. Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid was milky and periodic acid–Schiff–positive, and Mycobacterium intracellulare was detected.

pmc-13434804.title: Probing non-ergodicity and symmetry via direct measurement of coherent scattering in a shaken rotor
pmc-13434804.creator: F. Arrouas, J. Hébraud, N. Ombredane, E. Flament, D. Ronco, N. Dupont, G. Lemarié, B. Georgeot, Ch. Miniatura, J. Billy, B. Peaudecerf, D. Guéry-Odelin

pmc-13550654.title: Mechano-electrochemically stable fibrous zinc-ion batteries with unified aramid nanofibres skeleton
pmc-13550654.creator: Yinan Yang, Zhaochang Chen, Xianda Ma, Bingyun Ma, Haochen Huang, Gang Xiao, Miaoyi Xu, Zewan Lin, Yanyan Shao, Ziyan Xiong, Weifeng Yang, Xiaoxu Zhao, Jin Zhang, Tao Cheng, Xuan Zhang, Yuanlong Shao
pmc-13550654.description: Hydrogel electrolyte-based fibrous zinc-ion batteries exhibit exceptional safety and flexibility, positioning them as promising candidates for wearable electronics. However, conventional hydrogel electrolyte-based fibrous batteries suffer from substantial interfacial mechanical mismatches between rigid electrodes and soft hydrogel electrolytes, leading to compromised mechano-electrochemical stability and inferior electrochemical performance under deformation.

pmc-13602227.title: Levofloxacin enhances 5-fluorouracil efficacy in colorectal cancer by activating the DDR-TP53-mitochondrial apoptosis axis
pmc-13602227.creator: Chenmeng Huang, Chenchen Sun, Han Wang, Ying Wei, Yufei Zhang, Wenfeng Li, Aping Yue, Yajing Yang, Jiajia Wang, Jindan Guo, Zhengxi Hu, Jiangyang Chi, Yongli Fan
pmc-13602227.description: Summary5-Fluorouracil (5-FU)-based regimens are a cornerstone of colorectal cancer (CRC) chemotherapy. Levofloxacin (LVF), a widely used fluoroquinolone antibiotic, has been reported to exhibit anticancer properties. We investigated LVF’s ability to enhance CRC chemosensitivity to 5-FU in cell lines, subcutaneous xenografts (Balb/c-nude mice), and spontaneous intestinal tumors (Apcmin/+ mice). LVF potentiated 5-FU-induced apoptosis in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-13651692.title: Cost-effectiveness of liquid biopsy screening for gastric cancer in the United States
pmc-13651692.creator: Jeong Yun Yang, Alice Agyekum, Kevin J Rouse, Sheila D Rustgi, Chin Hur
pmc-13651692.description: BackgroundDespite the frequent late-stage diagnosis of gastric cancer (GC), the United States lacks a routine GC screening program. Liquid biopsy (LB), specifically blood-based tests, has emerged as a potential screening approach, but it is unclear whether such a strategy is cost-effective. We, therefore, evaluated the cost-effectiveness of LB screening for GC in the United States.
